query: OSHA 1910.147(d)(6) verification of isolation lockout tagout

results.query: OSHA 1910.147(d)(6) verification of isolation lockout tagout
results.snippet: Verification of isolation. Prior to starting work on machines or equipment that have been locked out or tagged out, the authorized employee shall verify that isolation and deenergization of the machine or equipment have been accomplished.
results.title: 1910.147 - The control of hazardous energy (lockout/tagout).
